license_note: The repository LICENSE file is the unmodified MIT License with a Microsoft Corporation copyright line and governs the published weights, tokenizer, and custom modeling code. The model card front matter links the same file, so the release is open source.

license_evidence.scope: microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct model weights, tokenizer, configuration, and custom modeling code

access_boundary: This record represents the microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct weight release at Hugging Face commit cfbefacb99257ffa30c83adab238a50856ac3083, last modified 2025-12-10. The Phi-4-mini-instruct-onnx repository, Phi-4-mini-reasoning, Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, community quantizations, and Azure-hosted deployments remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Microsoft publishes ungated Safetensors weights with a repository license file and a companion ONNX repository for the same release
The model card documents Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and Docker Model Runner serving paths and names Azure AI Studio as a managed option
tradeoffs: The repository ships custom modeling code and pins specific library versions, so runtime upgrades need independent checking
The model card gives a release month and a static-model statement but no changelog for later repository commits
